user.title: Set up PPL CZ
user.description: Enter the e-mail address of your mojePPL account. PPL CZ will send a PIN to that address.

code.title: Enter the PIN
code.description: Enter the PIN PPL CZ e-mailed to {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: PPL CZ sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: PPL CZ no longer accepts the stored session for {email}. Request a new PIN to sign in again.

error.invalid_pin: That PIN was rejected — it may be wrong or expired. Request a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach PPL CZ. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That PPL CZ account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That PIN is for a different PPL CZ account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Costs one extra request per parcel per refresh. Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks PPL CZ for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on PPL CZ's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.
